goal: Detect clean-merging pull requests that fail to build or pass tests against latest master
Saves contributors and maintainers from having to manually rebase or retest for silent breakages
reviewability: Ready for review because nothing is known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: a malicious PR could abuse the runner to mark all PRs as failing CI (fjahr)
Support for putting the check in CI or running it under DrahtBot (maflcko)
Approach approval prior to raising the runner security concern (fjahr)
Question on whether applying multiple labels at once could cause misbehavior (Sammie05)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it reduces maintainer friction by catching clean-merging build breakages early
It automates build failure detection for pending branches without changing core build systems

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it surfaces semantic test failures caused by newly merged master changes automatically
It adds speculative test execution for open PRs instead of strengthening test framework signal
